### [Search-R1: Training LLMs to Reason and Leverage Search Engines with Reinforcement Learning](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.09516>)

Search-R1 trains language models to alternate reasoning with search queries, using answer-level rewards and masking retrieved passages out of the policy loss. It provides an open recipe for learning when and how to obtain external evidence instead of relying only on a fixed retrieval step before answering.

**Evidence:** research-paper; full-text. The inspected v5 paper specifies interleaved rollout generation, retrieval-token masking and comparisons on seven general and multi-hop question-answering datasets; code and checkpoints are linked from the accessible repository. The first submission is March 12, 2025 and the inspected revision is August 5, 2025.

**Limitations:** The reported gains concern the tested models, retrieval setup and answer-scoring protocol. They do not establish general web-research reliability, source trustworthiness or resistance to malicious retrieved text.
